## Introduction

This paper demonstrates the SDBS publish pipeline @sdbs2025.

The publish pipeline captures:

1. TeX source files from `quarto render --to tex`
2. The compiled PDF
3. Clean markdown for machine readability
4. C2PA signing (when configured)
5. Structured metadata

## Methodology

We use a simple approach:

$$
E = mc^2
$$

See Figure @fig-demo for a visualization of the pipeline.

![SDBS Publish Pipeline](pipeline.png){#fig-demo}

## Results

The publish bundle is generated at `_publish/paper/` with the following structure:

```text
_publish/paper/
├── source/
│   ├── paper.tex
│   ├── _files/
│   └── ...
├── paper.pdf
├── paper.md
├── c2pa_manifest.json
└── metadata.yaml
```
